title: Chapter 97 Ao Qing Is In A Bottleneck
content:
Chapter 97 Ao Qing Is In A Bottleneck

The reason why this place was not conquered by those powerful star domains is not because the environment here is barren and not worth it.

Lu Daosheng looked at Jiangbei and said slowly, "Jiangbei, you have left the Wuling Star Domain before and have been to other places, right?"

Hearing this, Jiang Bei was stunned.

Although I didn't understand how Lu Daosheng learned it, Jiang Bei still said respectfully: "My Lord, my subordinates have indeed left the Wuling Star Domain. At that time, my subordinates were young and energetic. The surrounding star domain was already invincible. I wanted to go there. A further star field, seeking a stronger opponent."

Speaking of this, Jiang Bei paused.

At this time, Lu Daosheng said, "But I encountered an obstacle, right?"

Jiang Bei nodded and said with a serious expression: "When I reached the most border of the Qingling Star Domain, it was hazy, and there was a natural barrier that seemed to be crossing there, blocking my way."

"However, with the current strength of my subordinates, if I get there again, I will definitely be able to pass."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng nodded and said slowly, "There is not a natural barrier, but a man-made one."

"What?!"

As soon as these words were spoken, Jiangbei was suddenly a little unbelievable.

Because of man, the strength of the person who took action is too terrifying.

As far as he knows, there was no such barrier in historical records a long time ago.

So it is very likely that this is caused by man. He thought of this possibility at that time, but he just didn't want to admit it.

Thinking of this, Jiang Bei's expression suddenly became solemn.

On the side, Yu Qingfeng frowned slightly and said, "If it was really caused by a strong man's attack, why did the other party do this? Is it protecting this place or,

As soon as these words came out, everyone became silent.

Huang Shou and others just came here, and they all seemed to understand what Jiang Bei and others said.

At this time, Lu Daosheng sighed, and a trace of complexity flashed in his eyes.

"This matter will be aside."

"What I want to say is that next, our first priority is to unify the Xuanling Star Domain first, followed by the Wuling Star Domain, the Qingling Star Domain and some other nearby star domains. After these star domains are completely unified, we Then he will fight against the other more powerful star fields."

As soon as he finished speaking, Yun Qi suddenly said excitedly: "Master Lord, is it true??"

This is going to fight.

And it was a big war.

For so long, he has been in the world of all spirits, and the creatures there are so weak for him.

He was just abusing food there, and he was already exhausted.

Now, there is finally something to do.

Looking at Yun Qi's excited look, Lu Daosheng shook his head helplessly.

Now the number of troops in the desert city has reached tens of millions, and they are well-equipped, all of which are the best equipment used. Such an army is very explosive when looking at the entire star field.

Among them, there is even a Star Fleet.

What is bad is just cultivation.

As long as Yunqi is given for a while, an army that is enough to sweep the entire star domain will inevitably be presented to Lu Daosheng.

What's more, Lu Daosheng has been secretly cultivating a secret force in his own hands.

All of these people are extremely terrifying.

Because they have almost nothing to do on weekdays, they only need cultivation, and the resources provided by Lu Daosheng are infinite, and the speed of improvement of their realm strength is even more perverted than those of Huang Shou and others.

However, this is Lu Daosheng's secret trump card. He will basically not start it unless he has to.

At this time, Jiang Bei suddenly said, "Mr. City Lord, the Wuling Star Domain, just leave it to your subordinates."

Yu Qingfeng also stepped forward and said, "The Qingling Star Domain can be solved by myself."

Upon hearing this, Lu Daosheng was silent for a moment and nodded. For those two star fields, Jiang Bei and the others had absolute dominance in their respective star fields. If they took action, there would be almost no obstacles.

And it can greatly reduce losses.

In fact, unifying these star fields is nothing compared to the current strength of the wasteland city.

After all, this is just the first step.

At this time, Lu Daosheng said, "After you two have handled it, you will go to the border of the Qingling Star Domain, guarding there, waiting for my order."

Hearing this, the two nodded without asking much.

As long as Lu Daosheng ordered, they would do it well.

After a while, each of them ordered their respective tasks.

The space-time tunnels in the two deserted cities will not be closed for the time being, which will facilitate the connection between the two deserted cities. Although opening the space-time tunnel will consume a lot of resources, it will almost cost money.

But will Lu Daosheng take that little resource seriously?

It does not exist.

Soon, a large number of people in the deserted city of Wanling Realm began to migrate collectively.

After learning about it, many powerful families in the city chose to enter Xinhuang City together, while the other part chose to continue to stay in the All Spirit Realm.

Xinhuang City represents new opportunities. For opportunities, some people who are not doing well in the world of all spirits will naturally not let go.

However, it is naturally not free to enter Xinhuang City.

Until three days later.

Population migration has finally come to an end.

At this time, the population in Xinhuang City finally became active.

On this day, the protective barrier of the deserted city disappeared.

Lu Daosheng sent two powerful Divine Lord Realm powerhouses he had secretly trained to guard the city gate.

For a moment, it caused shock to the entire Xuanling Star Domain.

The dazzling divine light almost illuminated half of the Xuanling Star Domain.

The word "Huangcheng" was also completely exposed to the eyes of the people in Xuanling Star Region.

At the same time, Jiemeng, one of the powerful forces in Xuanling Star Region, suddenly had a war with a mysterious force, and Jiemeng was defeated.

Seeing this, many people were secretly shocked.

The great era is coming.

In a room in the Lord's Mansion of Huangcheng.

Dongdongdong!

"Come in."

Lu Daosheng said lightly.

The next moment, with a creak, Lu Xue pushed open the door and said weakly: "Dad, are you looking for me?"

Looking at Lu Xue, Lu Daosheng smiled and said: "I'm not looking for you, I'm looking for Ao Qing."

Hearing this, Lu Xue looked puzzled.

This stupid dragon usually sleeps and does nothing. Why does Dad want to find him?

Could it be that because this stupid dragon does nothing, he is going to be fired?

Thinking of this, Lu Xue's eyes revealed a trace of reluctance. After spending time together day and night, even if Ao Qing is unreliable, there will definitely be feelings.

Lu Xue looked at her father and hesitated: "Dad, did Xiaoqing do something wrong?"

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng smiled and said: "That's not the case, but, didn't you find that Ao Qing is a little bit wrong these days?"

Hearing this, Lu Xue was slightly stunned.

"Abnormal? No, this guy just sleeps all the time."

Lu Daosheng shook his head.

Ao Qing has been sleeping all the time, not because he is lazy and loves to sleep, but because Ao Qing, as a dragon, must digest the energy through sleep after absorbing a lot of energy.

In recent days, Ao Qing has absorbed too much energy.

There is no way, because the resources in the deserted city are too good, Ao Qing basically has everything he wants.

Now, Ao Qing has reached a bottleneck, and the energy cannot be absorbed completely, and the energy absorption has not stopped. If this continues, something may really happen.

If Lu Daosheng hadn't found it in time, Ao Qing might have really died in his sleep one day.

Lu Daosheng stretched out his hand and pulled Ao Qing out of Lu Xue's sleeve. At this time, Ao Qing was sleeping like dead.

Seeing this scene, Lu Xue finally realized that something was wrong.

"Dad, Xiaoqing..."

Lu Xue said with some worry.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng smiled lightly and said, "It's okay, just help him get through."

"Get through?"

Lu Daosheng nodded.

The next moment, there was a loud bang.

A scream suddenly came from the house, resounding through the sky!
